title: Spec AC 'scale x1.50 at 1152x648, no HUD overlap anywhere' has no durable pin — harness renders only at 1280x720
evidence: Spec (chunk-rest.patch, spec-7-3-accessibility-core.md): '- Given scale ×1.50 at 1152×648, then no HUD overlap anywhere (top band, QoS, tray, captions, panel).' and I/O matrix: '| Scale ×1.50 at min window 1152×648 | panel stepper | top band (health card, forecast, crisis banner), QoS panel, tray, caption strip never overlap | layout clamps, AC-pinned |' and task: 'Pin ACs as durable tests where the layers allow (palcheck legs, parity legs, settings round-trip)'. Worktree harness/goldens.odin:80: 'rnd.view_compute(&rc.view, 1280, 720, &cat.balance)' (palcheck.odin:245 likewise 1280x720). demos/a11y_scale.dem pins only 'a11y scale 150' at that default resolution. A repo-wide grep for '1152' finds only app/main.odin comments (MIN_WIN_W :: 1152); no test/golden at min window exists.
detail: The frozen spec pins the no-overlap guarantee at the min window 1152x648 under x1.50 ('AC-pinned'), but the a11y_scale golden captures only 1280x720. The min-window x1.50 overlap AC is unverified by any durable test.
recommended_fix: Add a durable min-window leg: a CPU-side rect-overlap assertion over the HUD surfaces (top band, QoS, tray, captions, panel) with view_compute at 1152x648 and ui_scale=1.5, or an 1152x648 capture golden.

title: Parity captures panel_row but never asserts it; scripted legs end in divergent focus rows despite PR body's 'identical end input-state' claim
detail: End input-state genuinely diverges across devices (panel_row 1 vs 0) and the captured field is never compared, so the PR's 'identical end input-state' claim holds only for panel-open. Minor: the in-code comment scopes the assert to '(panel closed)'.
recommended_fix: Either assert panel_row parity in check_states (e.g. reset focus on close in exec.odin so all devices end at row 0), or narrow the PR-body claim to match the asserted invariant.
